objective: Set trigger.type to sensor for action_command scripts and support user selection of next_flow_ids in FlowDetailDrawer without hardcoding empty arrays.

acceptance.criterion: buildIrFromGraph sets trigger.type to sensor for action_command kind.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test sets trigger type to sensor for action_command kind in buildIr.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: buildIrFromGraph accepts nextFlowIds parameter and maps it to ir.next_flow_ids, defaulting to empty array if omitted.
acceptance.verification: Vitest tests passes nextFlowIds through to the IR and defaults nextFlowIds to empty array in buildIr.test.ts

acceptance.criterion: FlowDetailDrawer renders checkbox UI for selecting next flows and includes chosen next_flow_ids when saving automation script.
acceptance.verification: Vitest test lets the user pick next flows and includes them when saving in FlowDetailDrawer.test.tsx
